intake.description: The claimant's car was stolen from outside their building in Salt Lake, Kolkata, between the night of October 18, 2026, and the morning of October 19, 2026. An FIR was registered with the police on October 23, 2026.
intake.severity_reason: Severity is high because the claim involves theft of a vehicle.

citations.quote: A theft claim is payable only if the theft was reported to the law-enforcement authority within 48 hours of the policyholder discovering it.
We pay for the loss of the insured vehicle, or of parts fitted to it, caused by theft, subject to MOTOR-CON-5.2.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant discovered the theft of her car on the morning of October 19, 2026. However, she did not report the theft to the law-enforcement authority until October 23, 2026, which exceeds the mandatory 48-hour reporting window required by policy condition MOTOR-CON-5.2. Since coverage for theft under MOTOR-COV-2.2 is explicitly subject to this reporting requirement, the claim is not covered.
